method.update: Q(s,a) += alpha * (r + gamma * max_a' Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)); target = r if terminal
method.action_selection: epsilon-greedy while training; greedy (epsilon=0) when playing this GIF

length.doc: Snake length bucket: board area split into equal slices (8x8 board -> 1-8, 9-16, ..., 57-64).

length.doc: Snake length bucket: board area split into equal slices (8x8 board -> 1-8, 9-16, ..., 57-64).

reward_details.apple: 1 when an apple is eaten (including the last one, which wins).
reward_details.death: 1 on collision or timeout (too long without eating).
reward_details.step: 1 on every ordinary move (no apple, no death): a small cost for wasting time.
reward_details.closer: Shaping: +1 if an ordinary move got closer to the apple, -1 if it got farther.
